name: io.github.Servosity/knowbe4-mcp
title: KnowBe4 MCP
description: Every KnowBe4 KMSAT reporting feature plus a local SQLite store that answers the cross-client

environmentVariables.name: KNOWBE4_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Set the KNOWBE4_API_KEY credential for the KnowBe4 MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: KNOWBE4_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Full API base URL. Leave blank: the CLI builds it from KNOWBE4_REGION. Set it only to point at a different host.

environmentVariables.name: KNOWBE4_REGION
environmentVariables.description: Your tenant's KnowBe4 server: us, eu, ca, uk or de. Builds the API base URL; default us.

environmentVariables.name: KNOWBE4_USER_EVENT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. The separate User Event API key (KnowBe4 User Event API Management Console > API key), used only by the events commands to push custom risk events. Sent only to the User Event API host for your region.

environmentVariables.name: KNOWBE4_USER_EVENT_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Overrides the User Event API host the events commands use. Leave blank to use the host for your KNOWBE4_REGION.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional: binds the MCP server to an existing tenant-gated Printing Press client profile. Leave unset for a single-tenant install.

environmentVariables.name: KNOWBE4_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any non-GET execute call. Preset to 1; clear it only when you want the agent to run the tools this switch hides.

environmentVariables.name: KNOWBE4_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API, the response cache is off, and sync refuses to run. Leave blank to keep the local store.

environmentVariables.name: KNOWBE4_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http. Not needed for the default local stdio transport.

environmentVariables.name: KNOWBE4_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on KnowBe4 requests.
